t: A tiny cube speaker and microphone for building your own voice assistant.
steps: Buy the Atom VoiceS3R from M5Stack or a store such as The Pi Hut.
Plug it into a computer with a USB-C cable to try the factory USB audio mode.
Set up Home Assistant with ESPHome 2026.10.0 or newer.
Hold the button until the green LED lights to enter download mode.
Flash the M5Stack ESPHome voice satellite config from the official guide.
Say the wake word "Okay Nabu" and ask it to turn on a light.
Explore UiFlow2 or Arduino to write your own sound projects.
